intrinsic_gauge_calibration.EDIT_2026-07-27: The 484-case loop included all 49 held-out cases. Recompute from the exact 435-case sampler before reuse.
description: reference_length = C * r_RMS(sample), with r_RMS the
measure-weighted RMS boundary radius about the measure-weighted
centroid.  C is calibrated ONCE on the DrivAerML TRAIN split as
8.0 / mean(r_RMS), so DrivAerML reproduces its historical operating
point and any other family lands at the same RELATIVE point.
C is never re-fit per evaluation set.
